rows.en: (Phew~ The morning air feels great...)
Oh? \p?
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders (bare name in the Japanese for both).

rows.en:
Huh, Sheryl?!
What are you doing out at this hour?

Nothing in particular.
I woke up, so I came out for a little fresh air.
Huh, so even you do that sometimes...
rows.notes: Male. 'sonna koto mo aru n da': surprised the superstar is up early for fresh air.

rows.en:
Frontier's air is nicer than the Galaxy fleet's.
Especially in the morning. It's something else!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. 'Galaxy' = the Galaxy fleet, as settled.

rows.en: Oh, is that so...

Well, if you've always lived on Frontier,
you wouldn't know. You'll understand someday,
when we reach a new planet. I'm sure of it.
Yeah, maybe so.

(Sheryl's been all over the place on tour,
after all...)
(Phew~ The morning air feels great...)

Huh, Sheryl-san?!
What are you doing out at this hour?
Huh, so even you do that sometimes...
Oh, is that so...
Yes, maybe so.

(Sheryl-san's been all over the place
on tour, after all...)
(The damage to the city... It's just too awful...)

I know this is a shock, things turning out
like this. But facts are facts.
We have to accept them.

And right now, we each do everything we can.
That's all we can do right now...
I'll do what I can do. See you.
(Sheryl's really strong...)
(The damage to the city... It's just too awful...)
Yes, you're right...
(Sheryl-san's really strong...)
(The tests are finally over. I'm beat~)
Ugh, what IS this?!
(Huh? What's up with Sheryl?)
Sheryl? What's wrong?
Don't "what's wrong" me! What is with this test?!
Meaning...?

Nothing I studied came up at all!
These questions have to be a mistake!

(She must've studied the wrong material...
I bet...)
rows.notes: Male. shiken han'i machigaeta = got the test range wrong.

rows.en:
Oh, whatever!
This kind of thing is worthless to me anyway!
That's... Sheryl for you...

(I guess schoolwork doesn't really matter
to someone like Sheryl.)
(The tests are finally over. I'm beat~)
(Huh? What's up with Sheryl-san?)
Sheryl-san? Is something wrong?
What do you mean...?

(She must've studied the wrong material...
I bet...)
That's... Sheryl-san for you...

(I guess schoolwork doesn't really matter
to someone like Sheryl-san.)
(Whoa, I dawdled and now look at the time!)
Ah, sorry, Sheryl!
rows.notes: Male; he just bumped into her.

rows.en:
Geez... Watch where you're going!
You're 300 million light-years too early
to bump into me!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. Kept the mixed-up unit: the player's next line points it out.

rows.en: ...Pretty sure light-years aren't a unit of time...
What? Did you say something?

No, nothing!
More importantly, are you hurt? You okay?

I'm fine. If I got hurt over something like this,
I'd never cut it as the "Galactic Fairy"!

...I don't think that has much to do
with getting hurt...
Oh, right, I've gotta hurry!
Hey, wait just a minute!
(There's so much to call Sheryl out on...)
(Aaah, I dawdled and now look at the time!)
Ah, I'm so sorry, Sheryl-san!
...Light-years aren't a unit of time, right...?

No, nothing!
More importantly, aren't you hurt?
(There's so much to call Sheryl-san out on...)
(Lunch break already? I'm starving.)

(Oh, it's Sheryl. Looks like she's having lunch.
I wonder what she's eating...)
Mmm~ So cold and yummy~!!
Wha?! Soft serve, of all things?!
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Callback to nml_she_001.

rows.en: Who's there?!

Oh, sorry.
I was just passing by...
You saw, didn't you...
Uh, um... Saw what?
Me eating hippo-cow soft serve for lunch!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. hippo-cow per glossary.

rows.en: Well, I did see it, but what about it?

Well, since you saw, it can't be helped...
You'd better keep this a secret from Grace.
If you tell her, I'll never forgive you!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. 'her' = Grace (female in glossary).

rows.en: Okay, got it~

(I see, Grace-san must have banned her
from sweets...)
rows.notes: Male. Grace-san as the player calls her (c19741).

rows.en: (Lunch break already~ I'm starving~)

(Oh, it's Sheryl-san. Looks like she's having
lunch. I wonder what she's eating...)

Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just passing by...
Uh, um... Saw what?
Yes, I saw it, but...?
Oh, um, okay...

(I see, Grace-san must have banned her
from sweets...)
